title: Meghan in talks to return to acting in Netflix's The Gentlemen
seoTitle: Meghan Markle in Talks for The Gentlemen Season 3
subtitle: The Duchess of Sussex is in talks to join the third season of the Netflix production created by Guy Ritchie.
excerpt: Meghan is reportedly in talks to star in the third season of Netflix's hit series The Gentlemen, a project not yet officially greenlit.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The Duchess of Sussex, Meghan, is in talks to return to acting in Netflix's hit crime series The Gentlemen. The possibility involves casting the actress in the television project.

According to information published by Variety, Meghan is holding discussions to join the third season of the show. To date, the third installment has not yet received official approval for production.

Production Details

The series The Gentlemen is a spin-off of the 2019 crime comedy film of the same name. Both creations feature Guy Ritchie as the creator of both the original movie and the derived television series.

In television productions and streaming projects, casting inquiries and conversations often take place alongside the planning stages for new seasons, preceding the formal confirmation of filming.

With information from The Guardian.
